title: NAB Credit Card Changes from 01 October 2026 - Announced
body:
NAB has updated their credit card page with the changes from 01/10/2026 for direct cards, name changes, reductions in benefits etc incoming: NAB Credit Card Updates
Rewards Signature Card renamed to Travel Card gains two lounge access passes at participating locations (not yet stated), but loses monthly fee waiver over $5K and moves back to an Annual Fee which is going to be $395. Points earning changes also noted. Not as bad as some may have thought it have been.
The Qantas Rewards Signature has changes to earn rates and also increases its annual fee to $449 which isn't on the above page (yet), but is on this one. NAB Credit Card Fees
Rewards changes don't appear to be up yet but will be at the following page it seems from FAQs on the above page: NAB Rewards Updates .
I guess we wait for the emails to come out now. Thoughts?
Edit: Seems someone put the details at a different link which came from the NAB Rewards website banner at the top.
Reward changes are here for Gift Cards, Cashback and Velocity plus the one off increase, other airline changes are showing on the Platinum website - seems to be similar to MyCard changes here . Interestingly the Cashback is worse with MyCard but the gift card redemption is worse with NAB.
